subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so should the accepted path be a default-off KaTeX/MathJax config surface with sanitizer and dependency review?
rationale: The feature fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a core UI dependency, user-facing config, and untrusted-rendering sanitizer surface that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one current KaTeX/MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, regression coverage, and real Control UI proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged for now and ask for a plugin/API design only if current extension points cannot safely support the behavior.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close this request and the related candidate PRs with a product rationale if first-party math rendering is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one current KaTeX/MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, regression coverage, and real Control UI proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate from the current Control UI renderer history and adjacent product/config ownership signals.
